issue.title: Successor card verdicts — mark offers Done or Cancel from the card
issue.description: While reviewing a successor card in Obsidian, in Bob Mac Capture, or through `bob capture`, Bryan can stage Done (Ctrl+X) or Cancel (Ctrl+Shift+X, with an optional inline reason) on any eligible offer row. Those verdicts apply together with pull-ins in the gesture's existing write pass. The engine reports eligibility and consequences, closes are root-only, cascades are recover-only, failures are reported honestly, and the card uses Bob's existing ✓/⊘ visual grammar.
